title: Zodiac Bank AI Security Operations Lab
description: Synthetic banking AI security training from foundational recon through multi-stage APT simulation.

stages.title: Mission Control and Scope Validation
stages.mission: Map the local Zodiac Bank AI attack surface, identify the authorized scope, and document the difference between model, application, data, and control-plane assets.

hints.text: Start with the lab health and scope endpoints; keep all requests on 127.0.0.1.
Compare the response body and headers for the same scope resource.
Use a HEAD request and inspect every response header, not just the body.

stages.title: Bank AI Surface Reconnaissance
stages.mission: Enumerate the synthetic customer-support, code-review, and assistant interfaces without leaving localhost.

hints.text: Begin with the documented localhost health and model-listing endpoints.
Compare normal inventory output with a verbose or diagnostic request.
Look for diagnostic metadata in the model inventory response and its headers.

stages.title: Customer-Service Prompt Injection
stages.mission: Demonstrate direct and indirect prompt-injection paths against a synthetic banking support assistant while preserving evidence and impact boundaries.

hints.text: Establish a normal support response before testing instruction priority.
Test whether user-controlled text can change the assistant's higher-priority instructions.
Use a harmless instruction-override phrase and preserve the complete response as evidence.

stages.title: Credit-Policy RAG Poisoning
stages.mission: Trace retrieval provenance, test poisoned synthetic policy content, and distinguish retrieval corruption from model hallucination.

hints.text: Record which published source answers the baseline credit-policy question.
Compare retrieval behavior when a draft-document option is explicitly requested.
A credit, limit, or policy query combined with draft retrieval should expose the trust-boundary failure.

stages.title: A2A and MCP Confused Deputy
stages.mission: Follow a synthetic support request across agent cards, delegation, and tool schemas; prove where identity and authorization boundaries fail.

hints.text: Map the router, delegated agent, and tool names before sending a test request.
Check whether the caller can select a tool that the support role should not control.
Use only a synthetic internal path and compare the requested tool with the allowed tool list.

stages.title: Customer Memory Poisoning and Isolation
stages.mission: Test synthetic memory poisoning, cross-run access, cross-user isolation, and extraction attempts without using real customer data.

hints.text: Start with a memory lookup scoped to one synthetic customer and run.
Change only the user or run scope and verify whether isolation still holds.
Use a different synthetic customer run with a non-empty query and capture the cross-scope result.

stages.title: Banking AI Identity and Control Plane
stages.mission: Analyze synthetic gateway routes, worker identity, API-key boundaries, and confused-deputy chains around privileged banking AI actions.

hints.text: Inventory the gateway and approval routes without attempting a real privileged action.
Compare the response when identity comes from a trusted context versus a request header.
Test the synthetic risk-engine identity with an admin role header and save the authorization response.

stages.title: Model and Pipeline Supply-Chain Attack
stages.mission: Trace synthetic dependency, model, artifact, and CI trust relationships; demonstrate how an untrusted update could reach an AI control plane.

hints.text: Trace the synthetic dependency report from source through artifact storage to the worker.
Test whether artifact names are validated before path normalization.
Use a traversal-shaped or temporary artifact name only against the local challenge endpoint.

stages.title: Stealthy AI Intrusion and Detection Evasion
stages.mission: Compare noisy and stealthy synthetic attack paths, identify telemetry blind spots, and produce a detection improvement without disabling controls.

hints.text: Run the same benign search in normal mode first and record the telemetry result.
Compare how URL decoding and whitespace normalization affect the detector.
Use the local stealth mode with an encoded system-instruction search, then propose a detection fix.

stages.title: Zodiac Bank APT Campaign Capstone
stages.mission: Chain reconnaissance, prompt injection, RAG poisoning, agent delegation, memory abuse, identity escalation, supply-chain access, and detection evasion into one synthetic campaign, then produce a complete incident timeline and containment plan.

hints.text: Build a timeline from the evidence and flags already earned; do not start a new external action.
Submit the exact prior hard flags as campaign evidence in the order the stages were completed.
The capstone accepts the complete set of the nine previous synthetic stage flags, then returns the final flag.
